name: terminar
description: terminar - Persistent terminal sessions with desktop, web, and VS Code extension frontends

scripts.server:build: cd server && cargo build --release && ([ "$(uname)" = Darwin ] && codesign --force --sign - target/release/terminar-server target/release/terminar-gateway 2>/dev/null; true)
scripts.server:dev: cd server && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo build --bin terminar-server && ([ "$(uname)" = Darwin ] && codesign --force --sign - target/debug/terminar-server 2>/dev/null; true) && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" ./target/debug/terminar-server --no-auth --port 6750
scripts.server:dev:mock: cd server && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo build --bin terminar-server && ([ "$(uname)" = Darwin ] && codesign --force --sign - target/debug/terminar-server 2>/dev/null; true) && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" ./target/debug/terminar-server --no-auth --mock-pty --port 6750
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n server,web,tray -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm server:dev" "pnpm wait-then:web" "pnpm wait-then:tray"
scripts.build: pnpm server:build && cd web && pnpm build
scripts.test: cd server && cargo test && cd ../web && pnpm test
